sf.label: Stockfish 19
sf.method: Baseline: unrestricted MultiPV 3 at every position, 10M nodes, last completed iteration. Candidate comparisons (60M nodes) and deep checks (200M nodes) restrict the root moves and keep their own budgets.

notes.text: The white rook on a7 can answer ...Rh5 with Ra6!, attacking the black queen on g6. 32.Rad7 abandons that resource; ...Rh5 attacks White’s queen and ...Rg5 increases the pressure. Local Lite at depth 21 shows almost no gap, but a constrained same-root d30 search finds about 4.70 pawns of score difference between 32.Kh1 and 32.Rad7.
Stockfish 19, 16 Nov 2026 (1 thread, 200M nodes, depth 42, deep check): Kh1 −0.21, played Rad7 −8.17 (mover POV). The catalog alternative is better by 7.96 pawns.
